bindingRule: The issued token must pin the clean pushed post-bridge dwp-dev commits in both repositories. Observed preparation commits are evidence, not authoring bases.

tokenIssueGates.requirement: MOD-PER-COMPPLAN producer and BASE-TFR-PAY-016 consumer result commits and exact XCON-020/XCON-021 bytes remain pinned.

Authorization v41 and V250, all five exact Payroll OpenAPI and Gateway routes, and the generated Payroll PEP projection with exact capability, action, population, field, purpose, step-up and SoD contract allocation are integrated and pushed to dwp-dev. Payroll owner runtime enforcement is not a pre-token gate.
Recheck the Payroll migration directory at the post-bridge backend commit, confirm V49 high-water and activate the exact V50 lease without collision.
Materialize dedicated backend and frontend worktrees from exact origin/dwp-dev heads; require empty porcelain, exact branch and matching base tree.
Seal post-bridge commits, Authorization successor checksum, work-packet hashes, V50 lease, touch manifest, worktree paths and clean-state digests into one issued token.

postTokenModuleObligations: implement dwp-payroll-server calculation and security owner runtime within the work-packet paths
consume the generated Payroll PEP projection and enforce tenant, population, field, purpose and action decisions
verify approve and finalize step-up evidence and maker-checker SoD in the Payroll owner runtime
prove the Payroll PEP, receipt authorization and PAY011-AC-01 through PAY011-AC-12 module tests
invalidationConditions: either repository worktree base, branch, tree, upstream or clean digest drifts
common bridge successor checksum or route set drifts
V50 collision or migration high-water drift
PAY-016 contract bytes or dependency commits drift
module touches a Control-only, protected, generated, recovery or unrelated path
customer data, external connector or production activation is attempted
